definition: CausesAllInGenus InAct CausesIn esse c: c causes the being of every distinct x that has esse. This is the existing predicate specialized to esse, not a new causal relation and not an identification with God, first being, maximality, or an uncaused cause.
note: Scope and finite interpretation for the existing causal vocabulary; semantic grounding, precise source locators, examples, rejected interpretations and remaining obligations: docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md. No new structural law is attributed to a source.
